data.description: Exclusive Residences by the Sea at Rena, Dubai Islands
data.long_description:
Situated on Dubai Islands, Rena is a luxurious 7-story residential complex offering only 64 exclusive residences, including 1-3 bedroom apartments, duplex townhouses, and a rare penthouse. This remarkable glass building, positioned directly on the sand, is designed to capture the essence of a coastal lifestyle, blending modern elegance with the natural beauty of the sea. Inside, wooden elements and sleek design lines create a sophisticated atmosphere, while abundant natural light enhances the sense of tranquility. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring in ample light, and soft furnishings paired with a serene color palette mirror the soothing tones of the shoreline.

Residents at Rena are offered a comprehensive range of high-end amenities, such as indoor parking, 24/7 security with a modern video surveillance system, and concierge services that cater to any needs. The development also includes a children's playground, a lush landscaped garden, an infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, and comfortable relaxation areas. Its prime location provides easy access to key areas: the Infinity Bridge is only 10 minutes away, while Dubai International Airport is just a 16-minute drive. Downtown Dubai is a 26-minute drive, and the DIFC business district is 24 minutes away. BurJuman Shopping Mall (16 minutes) and Dubai Mall (26 minutes) are within reach, along with prestigious institutions such as Victoria International School (16 minutes) and world-class healthcare facilities like Dubai Hospital (8 minutes).
